title: 第19章鼎变
novel_title: 凡人修仙：从废器房杂役开始
content_zh:
门栓插上以后，陈青山先低头。

    门槛里有血。

    一滴，黄豆大，卡在灰砖缝旁边。

    这玩意儿比肩背上的伤还扎眼。伤能藏在衣服底下，地上的血不行。

    他摸到桌脚下那块旧抹布，往血点上一按。

    肩背那块肉跟着一抽，疼得眼前白了一下。

    “操。”

    声音压得很低。

    血被抹开，反倒更显。他又用指甲抠砖缝，混着炉灰反复蹭。蹭到最后，指甲缝里全是黑灰和血。

    看不出来了。

    至少乍一眼看不出来。

    陈青山扶着桌腿坐下，手往背后一摸，摸了一手黏。

    道袍和伤口粘死了。

    他端起半碗隔夜凉水，反手往肩背上一倒。凉水顺着背往下淌，激得他牙齿磕了一下。

    衣料软了点。

    他咬住布角，左手按墙，右手往下揭。揭到最后，还是连皮带肉一块撕开。

    刺啦。

    陈青山额头抵住墙，半天没喘上气。

    灰布面具死时那双眼睛又冒了出来。

    他扶着墙干呕两下，只吐出一点酸水。

    不能想。

    昨晚不杀那人，今天躺沟里的就是自己。

    止血散是从灰布面具身上摸来的。

    陈青山先挑一点抹在手背上，等了十几息。

    不麻，不痒。

    药粉撒上去，凉意往肉里钻。他用布条缠肩背，够不着的地方就用牙咬着扯。包得歪歪扭扭，血倒慢慢止了。

    屋里多了药味。

    血衣还在脚边。

    烧不得，味儿太重。拿出去扔，更蠢。

    陈青山扒出练手炉里的冷灰，一层层盖在血衣上，又碾碎一块废炭抹上去。血味淡了，焦灰味冲起来。

    他掀开床底靠墙那块松砖。

    血衣塞进去。

    北山图塞进去。

    黑令牌到手上时，他停了一下。

    正面龙纹，背面一个“北”。

    坊市里的金色龙纹、北山图上的玄片、这块北字令牌，是一串的。

    扔了，线断。

    留身上，一搜就死。

    陈青山拿油纸裹了两层，又撕半截旧袖子裹一层，塞到洞最里头。松砖按回去，撒灰，用鞋底蹭平。

    刚蹭完，墙那边咚了一声。

    “老陈？”

    周小满的声音闷在墙后。

    “你屋里什么味儿？糊了？”

    陈青山看着床底。

    “炉子。”

    “啊？”

    “昨晚炼废了，炉灰没倒。”

    墙那边安静了一会儿。

    “你们炼器的真有病，大早上也闻得下去。”

    陈青山没接话。

    接多了容易露。

    周小满又道：“对了，早上柳青霜师姐那边来人了。”
content_en:
After the door bolt was inserted, Chen Qingshan lowered his head first.

    There is blood in the threshold.

    A drop, as big as a soybean, was stuck next to a crack in the gray brick.

    This thing is more eye-catching than the wounds on his shoulders and back. Injuries can be hidden under clothes, but blood on the ground cannot.

    He touched the old rag at the foot of the table and pressed on the blood spot.

    The piece of flesh on the back of my shoulder twitched, and the pain made my eyes turn white.

    "Fuck."

    The voice was kept low.

    The blood was wiped away, but it became more visible. He dug into the cracks of the bricks with his nails and rubbed them with ashes. By the end, the nails were filled with black ash and blood.

    Can't see it anymore.

    At least not at first glance.

    Chen Qingshan sat down holding on to the legs of the table and touched his hand behind his back, feeling sticky.

    The robe and the wound were stuck together.

    He picked up half a bowl of overnight cold water and poured it onto his shoulder. The cold water trickled down his back, making him chatter his teeth.

    The fabric is a little softer.

    He bit the corner of the cloth, pressed the wall with his left hand, and pulled it down with his right hand. At the end of the process, the skin and flesh were torn apart.

    Stab.

    Chen Qingshan pressed his forehead against the wall and couldn't breathe for a long time.

    The eyes appeared again when the gray cloth mask died.

    He held the wall and retched twice, spitting out only a little acidic water.

    Can't think.

    If you didn't kill that person last night, you would be the one lying in the ditch today.

    The bleeding powder was obtained from the gray cloth mask.

    Chen Qingshan first picked a little and applied it on the back of his hand, then waited for more than ten breaths.

    Not numb or itchy.

    Sprinkle the medicinal powder on it, and the coolness penetrates into the meat. He wrapped strips of cloth around his shoulders and back, biting and tugging at the places that were out of reach. The wrapping was crooked, and the bleeding slowly stopped.

    The room smells of medicine.

    The bloody clothes were still at his feet.

    Can't be burned, the smell is too strong. Taking it out and throwing it away would be even stupider.

    Chen Qingshan scooped out the cold ashes from the hand-training furnace, covered it layer by layer on the bloody clothes, and then crushed a piece of waste charcoal and spread it on. The smell of blood faded away, and the smell of burnt ash became stronger.

    He lifted up the pine brick under the bed against the wall.

    Tuck in the bloody clothes.

    The picture of Beishan is stuffed in.

    When the black token came into his hand, he paused.

    There is a dragon pattern on the front and a "north" on the back.

    The golden dragon pattern in Fangshi, the mysterious piece on the map of Beishan, and this north-character token are all in one string.

    Throw it away, the line is broken.

    If you keep it on your body, you will die if you search it.

    Chen Qingshan wrapped two layers of oil paper, tore off half of an old sleeve, wrapped it one layer, and stuffed it into the innermost part of the hole. Press the loose bricks back, sprinkle with dust, and rub them flat with the soles of your shoes.

    Just after rubbing it, there was a bang on the other side of the wall.

    "Old Chen?"

    Zhou Xiaoman's voice was muffled behind the wall.

    "What does your room smell like? It's muddy?"

    Chen Qingshan looked under the bed.

    "Stove."

    "Huh?"

    "The refining was done last night and the ashes were not poured out."

    It was quiet for a while on the other side of the wall.

    "You refiners are really sick. You can smell it even in the morning."

    Chen Qingshan did not answer.

    If you take too many, it will be easy to expose.

    Zhou Xiaoman added: "By the way, someone came from Senior Sister Liu Qingshuang this morning."
